properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.x — the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 key/IV derivation, declared in both lockfiles as a transitive dependency of browserify-aes/browserify-cipher (the browserify crypto shim). Root lockfile: dev-only build/test toolchain of the crypto-pro library; react example: react-scripts build toolchain. The shipped library never calls it — it ships in node_modules of the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.x (OpenBSD bcrypt-PBKDF password KDF — not the bcrypt password hash) is a transitive dependency of sshpk (OpenSSH key parsing). Root lockfile: dev-only chain coveralls→request→http-signature→sshpk; react example lockfile: react-scripts toolchain. No application call site; it ships in the build's node_modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.1 (dev:true) is required by selfsigned@2.1.1, which webpack-dev-server (under @angular-devkit/build-angular 15.0.5) uses to generate a self-signed HTTPS certificate for the Angular dev server. node-forge supplies the RSA key generation + X.509 machinery. No application call site — dev toolchain only; the Angular example app itself does its crypto through the crypto-pro CAdES plugin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Misclassified family, real asset: the constant is CADESCOM_ENCRYPTION_ALGORITHM_GOST_28147_89 = 25 — GOST 28147-89, the Soviet-era Russian 64-bit block cipher and predecessor of GOST R 34.12-2012 (Magma), NOT Camellia/ARIA/SM4. Exported plugin-API identifier with no encryption call site in this library (presence, not use). Its 64-bit block puts it in the Sweet32 class, and Russia itself has deprecated it in favor of GOST R 34.12-2012.
